title: 第3章妇道人家第20章 我没有儿子
slug: 莫欺老年穷一天增加一个天赋点
lines: 总堂之内，气氛随着陈安的踏入，瞬间变得有些微妙。
“陈叔，您可算来了！”
秦虎洪亮的声音里满是压不住的喜悦，他蒲扇般的大手拍在桌案上，震得茶杯一跳，大步流星地从主位上走下，就要来迎接陈安。
然而，他身旁那身材丰腴的妇人却冷哼一声，端坐不动。
她正是秦虎的妻子，柳青月。
还不等秦虎拉住陈安的手，柳青月的声音已然响起。
“镖局家大业大，每天几十号人张嘴吃饭，开销也大，可不是什么闲人都能养活的。”
柳青月的声音不大，却能够传入每个人的耳朵里。
总堂内的空气，瞬间凝固。
“娘！您说什么呢！”
秦婉儿脸上闪过一丝焦急与难堪，跺了跺脚。
“你懂什么？”柳青月柳眉一竖，直接伸手拉住秦婉儿的胳膊，“跟我去后院，别在这儿碍事。”
秦婉儿还想再说，却被母亲强行拽着往后堂走，临走前，只能不忘回头给了陈安一个满是歉意的眼神。
秦虎的脸色变得异常尴尬，一张黝黑的方脸涨成了猪肝色。
他重重叹了口气，对着陈安苦笑道：“陈叔，您……您别往心里去。内人她……她就是个操持家务的妇道人家，头发长见识短，总惦记着柴米油盐，没有恶意。”
“我懂，我懂。”
陈安摆了摆手。
当初陈安不愿意接受秦虎的好意，其中也有一点是因为柳青月。
柳青月这个人说坏也不坏，但因为在秦虎尚未崛起之前就跟着秦虎，多少有些斤斤计较，对镖局内的一切，都是精打细算的。
只是现在的陈安，心性已然变得有些不同了。
若是以前，或许还会涨红了脸，为了那点可怜的面子拂袖而去。
可现在，他只觉得可笑。
面子能当饭吃？
能让他多活几年？
能让他感应气血，踏入武道？
都不能！
见陈安非但没有动怒，反而一脸淡然，秦虎心中愈发敬重，同时也松了口气。
他领着陈安走出总堂，穿过喧闹的演武场，来到大门旁一间独立的院落前。
这小院闹中取静，青石铺地，一角还种着一棵老槐树。
“陈叔，委屈您了，我给您安排了个看门的活计。”秦虎指着院子，脸上带着一丝歉意，“您别嫌弃，这活最是清闲，不用风吹日晒，也无人打扰。您就住这院里，吃住镖局全包了，每月我再给您支一两银子的月钱。”
一两银子！
这几乎是雷云县一个壮劳力一个月的工钱，足够寻常三口之家一个月的嚼用了。而他要做的，仅仅是看个门。
陈安看着眼前这间虽小，却被打扫得干干净净的屋子，心中涌起一股久违的暖流。
他没有推辞，只是郑重地对秦虎道：“秦大当家，这已经太好了，多谢。”
“陈叔，您再说这话，就是打我秦虎的脸了！”秦虎连忙扶住陈安，眼神恳切，“当年要没有您，我早就成了山里野兽的粪便！您安心住下，有什么需要只管开口！”
安顿好陈安后，秦虎还有镖局事务要处理，便匆匆离去。
陈安推开房门，关上。
content_en:
In the main hall, the atmosphere instantly became a little subtle as Chen An entered.
"Uncle Chen, you are finally here!"
Qin Hu's sonorous voice was full of uncontrollable joy. His big hand like a cattail leaf slapped on the table, which made the tea cup jump. He strode down from the main seat and was about to greet Chen An.
However, the plump woman next to him snorted coldly and sat still.
She is Qin Hu's wife, Liu Qingyue.
Before Qin Hu could hold Chen An's hand, Liu Qingyue's voice sounded.
"The Escort Agency has a big business. Dozens of people open their mouths to eat every day, and the expenses are huge. Not just anyone can support them."
Liu Qingyue's voice was not loud, but it could reach everyone's ears.
The air in the main hall suddenly solidified.
"Mom! What did you say!"
Qin Wan'er's face flashed with anxiety and embarrassment, and she stamped her feet.
"What do you know?" Liu Qingyue raised her eyebrows and directly reached out to hold Qin Waner's arm, "Follow me to the backyard, don't get in the way here."
Qin Wan'er wanted to say more, but her mother forcibly dragged her to the back hall. Before leaving, she could only turn around and give Chen An an apologetic look.
Qin Hu's face became extremely embarrassed, and his dark square face turned the color of pig liver.
He sighed heavily, smiled bitterly at Chen An and said: "Uncle Chen, you... don't take it to heart. My wife... she is just a woman who takes care of the housework. She has long hair and short knowledge. She always thinks about daily necessities. There is no malicious intention."
"I understand, I understand."
Chen An waved his hand.
Chen An was unwilling to accept Qin Hu's kindness, partly because of Liu Qingyue.
Liu Qingyue is not a bad person at all, but because she followed Qin Hu before Qin Hu rose to prominence, she is somewhat fussy about everything in the escort agency.
It's just that Chen An's mind has become a little different now.
If it were before, I might have blushed and walked away just for the sake of that pitiful face.
But now, he just thinks it's ridiculous.
Can face be used as food?
How many more years can he live?
Can it allow him to sense Qi and blood and step into the martial arts?
None!
Seeing that Chen An was not angry, but had a calm expression on his face, Qin Hu respected him more and more, and at the same time he breathed a sigh of relief.
He led Chen An out of the main hall, passed through the noisy martial arts arena, and came to an independent courtyard next to the gate.
This small courtyard offers tranquility amid the bustle, with bluestone paving and an old locust tree planted in one corner.
"Uncle Chen, I feel sorry for you. I have arranged a job as a janitor for you." Qin Hu pointed to the yard with a hint of apology on his face, "Don't dislike it. This job is the most leisurely. It doesn't need to be exposed to the wind and sun, and no one will disturb you. You will live in this courtyard, and the food, accommodation and escorts will be all covered. I will give you one tael of silver every month."
One tael of silver!
This is almost a month's wages for a strong laborer in Leiyun County, enough to feed an ordinary family of three for a month. And all he has to do is just look at the door.
Chen An looked at the small but clean room in front of him, and felt a long-lost warmth in his heart.
He did not refuse, but solemnly said to Qin Hu: "Master Qin, this is great, thank you very much."
"Uncle Chen, if you say this again, you will slap Qin Hu in the face!" Qin Hu quickly supported Chen An with a sincere look in his eyes, "Without you, I would have become the dung of wild beasts in the mountains! You can stay here in peace and just ask if you need anything!"
After settling Chen An, Qin Hu still had matters to deal with in the escort agency, so he left in a hurry.
"Squeak..."
Chen An pushed open the door and closed it.
title_en: Chapter 3: A Woman's Family Chapter 20: I Have No Son
